name: @yottameta/yotta-guardian
description: Yuandun (元盾) — cross-agent dangerous tool-call guardrail: a deterministic rule engine + pluggable intent verifier (model-agnostic) that evaluates exec/write/edit/read/run/shell calls and provides audit logs. Triggers when an agent is about to run a high-risk command, write sensitive paths, or change system config. Boundaries: read-only evaluation by default, configurable allowances.
